_meta.description: Справочник критичных веществ для автоматической вставки Safety-блоков в EBM-теги. Источник: project/EBM_STANDARD_v2.0.md (v3.1) §4-5.
_meta.usage: Скрипт scripts/ebm_reformat.ps1 при обнаружении любого из triggers в тексте EBM-блока добавляет строку '⚠️ **Safety:** <safety>'. Порог dose_threshold (если указан) — Safety обязателен при указанной дозе и выше.
_meta.note: triggers — регистронезависимые подстроки/формы вещества. Не выдумывать данные: safety-тексты выверены по IOM/EFSA/WHO.

selenium.label: селен
selenium.safety: Upper limit 400 mcg per day (IOM). Selenosis above 900 mcg per day: alopecia, brittle nails, garlic breath, GI symptoms.

iodine.label: йод
iodine.safety: Upper limit 500-1100 mcg per day; excess iodine may trigger thyroid dysfunction (Wolff-Chaikoff), caution in autoimmune thyroiditis and nodular goiter.

iron.label: железо
iron.safety: Contraindicated in hereditary hemochromatosis and iron overload. Upper limit 45 mg per day (adults); doses above cause GI distress and oxidative stress.

copper.label: медь
copper.safety: Upper limit 10 mg per day (IOM). Contraindicated in Wilson disease. High zinc intake depletes copper — monitor ratio.

zinc.label: цинк
zinc.safety: Upper limit 40 mg per day (IOM). Chronic intake above 40 mg per day depletes copper, causing anemia and neuropathy. Take apart from iron and calcium.

manganese.label: марганец
manganese.safety: Upper limit 11 mg per day (IOM). Excess is neurotoxic (manganism); caution in cholestasis and liver disease (impaired excretion).

chromium.label: хром
chromium.safety: Generally well tolerated up to 200-1000 mcg per day; caution with antidiabetic drugs (additive glucose lowering). Rare hepatic/renal reports at very high doses.

molybdenum.label: молибден
molybdenum.safety: Upper limit 2 mg per day (IOM). Excess interferes with copper metabolism; high intake may raise uric acid.

vitamin_a.label: витамин A
vitamin_a.safety: Upper limit 10000 IU (3000 mcg RAE) per day. Teratogenic — contraindicated in pregnancy above UL. Chronic excess: hepatotoxicity, bone loss, intracranial hypertension.

vitamin_d.label: витамин D
vitamin_d.safety: Upper limit 4000 IU per day (IOM) without monitoring. Excess causes hypercalcemia, hypercalciuria, nephrocalcinosis. Monitor 25-OH-D and calcium at high doses.

vitamin_e.label: витамин E
vitamin_e.safety: Upper limit 1000 mg per day (~1500 IU). Doses above 400 IU per day increase bleeding risk; caution with anticoagulants/antiplatelets and before surgery.

vitamin_k.label: витамин K
vitamin_k.safety: Contraindicated / requires INR monitoring with warfarin (antagonizes anticoagulation). Keep intake stable if on vitamin K antagonists.

vitamin_b6.label: витамин B6
vitamin_b6.safety: Upper limit 100 mg per day (IOM). Chronic intake above 100-200 mg per day causes sensory peripheral neuropathy (usually reversible on cessation).

dhea.label: DHEA
dhea.safety: Hormone precursor — androgenic/estrogenic effects. Contraindicated in hormone-sensitive cancers (breast, prostate, ovarian). Not for pregnancy/lactation. Physician supervision required.

pregnenolone.label: прегненолон
pregnenolone.safety: Steroid hormone precursor with unpredictable downstream conversion. Contraindicated in hormone-sensitive conditions; avoid in pregnancy/lactation. Physician supervision required.

melatonin.label: мелатонин
melatonin.safety: Doses above 3 mg per day may cause grogginess, vivid dreams, and morning sedation. Caution with anticoagulants, antihypertensives, and in autoimmune disease. Avoid driving after intake.

ashwagandha.label: ашваганда
ashwagandha.safety: Not recommended during pregnancy (abortifacient risk). Caution with thyroid hormone therapy (may raise T4/T3) and immunosuppressants. Rare hepatotoxicity reports.

curcumin.label: куркумин
curcumin.safety: Caution with anticoagulants/antiplatelets (additive bleeding risk) and gallstones/biliary obstruction (stimulates bile). May reduce iron absorption at high doses. Rare hepatotoxicity.

saccharomyces_boulardii.label: S. boulardii
saccharomyces_boulardii.safety: Contraindicated in critically ill, immunocompromised patients, and those with central venous catheters — risk of fungemia (case reports). Not for children under 2 years without medical supervision.

lactobacillus.label: определённые Lactobacillus
lactobacillus.safety: Generally safe in immunocompetent hosts. Caution / avoid in severely immunocompromised, critically ill, or central-catheter patients — rare bacteremia/sepsis case reports. Not for infants without supervision.
